facts.material: synthetic rubber, unvulcanized (polymer type not stated)
facts.form: primary forms (soft natural and standard natural grades), unvulcanized

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 4002 covers synthetic rubber in primary forms or in plates, sheets or strip; chapter 40 note 1 includes synthetic rubber in 'rubber'
Heading 4001 (natural rubber) excluded because goods are synthetic; heading 4005 applies only if compounded, which is not stated
GRI 6: polymer type not named among 4002.11-4002.70, not latex, so residual 4002.99 'Other'

rejected_alternatives.reason: covers natural rubber; goods described as synthetic rubber
compounded unvulcanized rubber; no compounding (carbon black, silica, other additives) described
mixtures of natural and synthetic rubber; no blend with heading 4001 rubber stated
isoprene rubber (IR) would apply if the polymer is synthetic polyisoprene; not stated

missing_facts: What is the chemical type of the synthetic rubber (SBR, BR, IR, EPDM, CR, NBR, etc.)?
Is it compounded with additives (heading 4005) or mixed with natural rubber (4002.80)?
Is it in latex form or solid (bales, sheets)?
classification.rationale: Unvulcanized synthetic rubber in primary forms falls in heading 4002 under GRI 1 and chapter 40 note 1. The 6-digit subheading turns on the polymer type, which the description does not give; 'soft natural' and 'standard natural' read like grade or color names, and a synthetic polyisoprene would go to 4002.60. Absent that fact the residual 4002.99.00.00 is the best guess, consistent with NY I87160 placing an unlisted synthetic rubber in 4002.99.
